description: NoSQL document database for modern applications

connectionString.description: Couchbase connection string (e.g., couchbase://localhost or couchbases://cloud.couchbase.com)

insert_document.name: insert_document
insert_document.description: Create a new document. Fails if document already exists.

scope.description: Select the scope (leave empty for default)

collection.description: Select the collection (leave empty for default)

documentId.description: Unique identifier for the document. Leave empty to auto-generate.

expiry.description: Document expiration time in seconds. Leave empty for no expiry.

durabilityLevel.description: How durable the write should be before returning success

aiMetadata.description: Create a new Couchbase document in a bucket/scope/collection, failing if a document with the same ID already exists. Use when you specifically need create-only semantics; choose Upsert Document instead to overwrite. Not idempotent: a stable ID fails on retry, and if the ID is left blank a fresh random UUID is generated each call, creating a new document.

upsert_document.name: upsert_document
upsert_document.description: Create or update a document. Creates if it doesn't exist, updates if it does.

scope.description: Select the scope (leave empty for default)

collection.description: Select the collection (leave empty for default)

documentId.description: Unique identifier for the document. Leave empty to auto-generate.

expiry.description: Document expiration time in seconds. Leave empty for no expiry.

durabilityLevel.description: How durable the write should be before returning success

aiMetadata.description: Write a Couchbase document by ID, creating it if absent and fully replacing it if present. Use to set a record to a known state regardless of whether it exists; choose Insert Document for create-only semantics. Idempotent when a stable document ID is supplied (same input yields the same stored state); leaving the ID blank generates a random UUID each call, which is not idempotent.

get_document.name: get_document
get_document.description: Retrieve a document by its ID

scope.description: Select the scope (leave empty for default)

collection.description: Select the collection (leave empty for default)

documentId.description: Select an existing document or type a custom ID

aiMetadata.description: Fetch a single Couchbase document by its key from a given bucket/scope/collection. Use to look up a known record by ID; the document ID is required and must reference an existing document or the call fails. Read-only and idempotent.

delete_document.name: delete_document
delete_document.description: Remove a document by its ID

scope.description: Select the scope (leave empty for default)

collection.description: Select the collection (leave empty for default)

documentId.description: Select an existing document or type a custom ID

durabilityLevel.description: How durable the write should be before returning success

aiMetadata.description: Remove a single Couchbase document by its key from a given bucket/scope/collection. Use to permanently delete a known record. Effectively idempotent on end state (the document ends up absent), though a repeat call on an already-deleted ID errors with a not-found.

query.name: query
query.description: Run a SQL++ (N1QL) query with optional vector search filters

scope.description: Select the scope (leave empty for default)

query.description: SELECT statement with optional positional parameters ($1, $2, etc.). Do not include LIMIT or OFFSET.

arguments.description: Values for positional parameters ($1, $2, etc.) in the query

vectorFilters.description: Filter results by vector similarity (requires vector index)

vectorExpr.description: Field path returning a vector (e.g., data.embedding)

targetVector.description: Array of numbers to compare against (e.g., [0.1, 0.2, ...])

preciseDistance.description: Use VECTOR_DISTANCE instead of APPROX_VECTOR_DISTANCE (slower but more accurate)

vectorOrder.description: Order results by vector similarity (requires vector index)

vectorExpr.description: Field path returning a vector (e.g., data.embedding)

targetVector.description: Array of numbers to compare against (e.g., [0.1, 0.2, ...])

preciseDistance.description: Use VECTOR_DISTANCE instead of APPROX_VECTOR_DISTANCE (slower but more accurate)

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return

aiMetadata.description: Run a read SQL++ (N1QL) SELECT query against Couchbase, optionally layering vector-similarity WHERE filters and ORDER BY for nearest-neighbor search; the query is wrapped as a subquery, so it must be a SELECT and must not contain LIMIT or OFFSET (use the Limit/Offset fields instead). Use for ad-hoc reads, joins, aggregations, or vector search across documents. Idempotent for read queries.
